# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m132/m147, with variable fonts and a reworked lifecycle. It adds variable font support, animated WebP encoding, color font palettes and several new APIs, and completes the v4 breaking-change story by promoting remaining v3 obsoletes to compile errors. This is a breaking release — read the changes below, especially the Vulkan and default-typeface behaviour changes, before upgrading from 3.x.

## Breaking Changes

- **Remaining pre-v4 obsolete members promoted to compile errors** — SKPaint text/font members and enum values that were marked [Obsolete] in v3 now emit compile errors in v4. Migration: switch to SKFont for text sizing and typeface assignment, and remove references to the removed enum values. ([#4195](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4195), [#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114))
- **new SKFont() now has an empty typeface, and new SKPaint().Typeface is never null** — Upstream removed the lazy 'resolve default at draw time' pattern. new SKFont().Typeface is now SKTypeface.Empty (MeasureText returns 0) instead of resolving a platform default, so construct with an explicit typeface and detect 'unset' via Typeface.IsEmpty. new SKPaint().Typeface now returns SKTypeface.Default instead of null; code that checked paint.Typeface == null to detect 'no typeface set' should use IsEmpty or drop the check. ([#3735](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3735), [#3736](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3736))
- **SKTypeface.FromFamilyName and SKTypeface.Default now resolve through the font manager** — FromFamilyName('missing') now returns SKTypeface.Default on every platform (including Android, which previously returned null), and SKTypeface.Default is now guaranteed non-null everywhere, including Android API 36+. For a strict 'was it found?' check, use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name), which still returns null on no match. ([#3737](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3737), [#3738](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3738))
- **SKStream.Move(long) now throws on overflow and is obsolete** — The overload always truncated large offsets to a 32-bit int silently. It now performs a checked cast and throws OverflowException for out-of-range values, and is marked [Obsolete] (CS0618). Call Move(int) with an in-range offset instead. ([#3740](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3740))
- **GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts the process on a Vulkan 1.0 instance instead of returning null** — Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1 and calls SK_ABORT (terminating the process, uncatchable) instead of returning null when the instance or backend context declares a lower version. Declare VK_API_VERSION_1_1 on both the VkInstance's apiVersion and GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion — leaving either at its default 0 is unsafe. Vulkan 1.0-only hardware can no longer run Ganesh Vulkan at all; pick another backend up front. ([#4600](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4600))
- **GRVkBackendContextNative loses five interop fields** — fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice are removed from the interop struct. Use fVkExtensions instead of fExtensions and fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2 instead of fFeatures; Skia no longer manages instance/device ownership through the backend context. The related GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo property also retypes from GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo, which adds a Components field and loses value-equality (Equals/== are removed). ([#3741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3741))

## Engine

- **Skia upgraded through milestones m132 to m148** — The v4 line's bundled Skia engine moves from m132 through m147 to m148 across the preview cycle, bringing upstream rendering, performance and stability fixes. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125), [#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4081), [#4044](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4044))

## API Surface

- **Variable font and color-font support added end-to-end** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp gain full variable font support (axis coordinates, named instances) and color font palette selection, plus a new HBColor struct for hb_color_t. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742), [#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000))
- **Animated WebP encoding and zero-copy stream reads** — SKWebpEncoder can now produce animated WebP output, and SKStream.GetData() converts a stream to SKData without an extra copy. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771), [#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **SKSamplingOptions support added to surface/canvas drawing** — SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface accept an SKSamplingOptions parameter for finer control over resampling filters. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491))
- **Linux Bionic and Tizen x64/arm64 native assets added** — New native asset targets bring SkiaSharp to Linux Bionic and add x64/arm64 native builds for Tizen. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))

## Bug Fixes

- **SKPixmap/SKBitmap GetPixelSpan pixel-access bugs fixed** — GetPixelSpan now correctly uses RowBytes for stride and the right axis for the pixel offset, instead of the wrong dimension. ([#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148), [#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128))
- **SKPath finalizer crash and WinUI/Uno fixes** — Fixes a finalizer crash in SKPath when its SKPathBuilder is collected first, the WinUI Projection DLL not being found for .NET 9 consumers, a Skottie package downgrade in the Uno gallery sample, and SKGLView not rendering after a MAUI TabBar tab switch on Android. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges), [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796), [#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084), [#3785](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3785), [#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))
- **Default-typeface resolution moved to the managed layer** — Fixes a crash where SKFontManager could return null on newer Android API levels by moving default-typeface resolution into managed code. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Singleton instance lifecycle reworked** — Reworks how SkiaSharp's process-wide singleton instances are created and torn down, and moves the native-compat gate from a module initializer into the SkiaApi static constructor for more predictable startup ordering. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080), [#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))

## Security

- **Bundled native dependencies refreshed** — libpng 1.6.58, libexpat 2.7.5/2.8.1, zlib 1.3.2.1-motley, freetype 2.14.3, libjpeg-turbo 3.1.4.1 and HarfBuzz 14.2.0 all pick up upstream security and bug fixes. ([#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717), [#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012), [#4035](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4035))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

Adds an HBColor value type, variable-font shaping and color-palette support, and refreshes the bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.0.

## Release Candidate 1 (June 12, 2026)

Release Candidate 1 promoted the remaining v3 obsolete members to compile errors, fixed the GetPixelSpan stride/offset bugs, reworked the singleton lifecycle, and updated to Skia m148.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.147.0-preview.3.1...v4.148.0-rc.1.2)

## Preview 3 (May 24, 2026)

Preview 3 finished the API pass with HBColor and missing HarfBuzz wrappers, dropped native WASM builds for pre-.NET 8 Emscripten, and picked up freetype 2.14.3, zlib 1.3.2.1-motley and libjpeg-turbo 3.1.4.1.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.147.0-preview.2.1...v4.147.0-preview.3.1)

## Preview 2 (May 6, 2026)

Preview 2 added animated WebP encoding, zero-copy SKStream.GetData(), the SKPath finalizer crash fix, and the Apple TFM realignment.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.147.0-preview.1.1...v4.147.0-preview.2.1)

## Preview 1 (April 28, 2026)

Preview 1 opened the v4 line: Skia m132 to m133 to m147, variable fonts, color font palettes, SKSamplingOptions on surface draws, the managed default-typeface fix, Tizen x64/arm64, Linux Bionic, and dependency refreshes for libpng/libexpat.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v3.119.4...v4.147.0-preview.1.1)
